import re
import uuid

import requests

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5000"


def test_register_then_login():
    s = requests.Session()
    username = "u_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    password = "pw123456"
    r = s.post(BASE + "/auth/register", data={"username": username, "password": password})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    r = s.post(BASE + "/auth/login", data={"username": username, "password": password}, allow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert "Log In" not in r.text or "Log Out" in r.text
    assert "Invalid username or password" not in r.text

cases.script_content:
import uuid

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5000"


def test_register_then_login_ui():
    username = "u_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    password = "pw123456"
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch()
        page = browser.new_page()
        page.goto(BASE + "/auth/register")
        page.fill("input[name=username]", username)
        page.fill("input[name=password]", password)
        page.click("input[type=submit]")
        page.goto(BASE + "/auth/login")
        page.fill("input[name=username]", username)
        page.fill("input[name=password]", password)
        page.click("input[type=submit]")
        page.wait_for_load_state()
        assert "Log Out" in page.content()
        browser.close()
